notes.title: Content Patch Inbound!
notes.content:
Hi all, development on just roll with it had been slow this last few months i had to take some time off but i have been back working at the project again and have some new content for you!
 
Content.

- NEW MAP - ARCTIC
- All levels now have music
- Improved audio balance
- Updated textures and shaders
- Improved Hub scene performance
- Improvements on particle effects
- All maps now have Unique terrains and improvements to lighting


BUGS
- After player feedback found some exploits on japan and toy room maps these have hopefully all been removed.
- End of level score ticking down after reaching goal has been fixed. Scores now freeze on completion.
- Countless collision issues and triggers (still working on some, shouldn't be as noticeable.)
- Issues with the water level not advancing past stage 5 fixed.
- Haunted map lacked a proper exit.


WHATS NEXT?

- I do have another map in the pipeline but its only early stages yet, It will most likely be a linear map like the water level with multiple stages. But before i start on that the game needs some attention in the background and early assets. When i began this project i had very little experience with how to structure a game from code to asset management and prefabs. And as the game gets bigger its become far more complicated to change things. I need to overhaul some of the earlier things i created and tidy up code, this process might take some time but when its finished i believe this game can leave early access.

Apart from that i will also be giving the GUI a complete overhaul, I also have a couple mini games that may be added in the future. 

Lastly the scoring when you  finish a level is very much a placeholder i need to test each level individually and come up with 3 goals to achieve in each based on time, speed and deaths. This is a slow process and requires a lot of testing. I hope the next content patch is sooner than this one.

Thanks all for the continued support.
~Team Spicy.
